data.title: Jeff Bezos’s Prometheus raises $12B to build an ‘artificial general engineer’ for the physical world

content.basic: The new round values the physical AI startup that aims to automate heavy engineering and drug design at $41 billion.

data.title: Theker just raised $85M to build the factory robot that doesn’t specialize in anything

content.basic: Unlike humanoid robots designed around a fixed form — think Boston Dynamics — Theker's machines are built to be reconfigured.
